pre_caption: This is an aerial landscape scenery shot depicting a vast, desolate expanse of pale, dried earth. The camera slowly pulls back to reveal enormous, undulating ridges in the ground, resembling a dried-out seabed or giant footprints. Scattered across this barren terrain are the minuscule-looking remnants of maritime life, including several decaying boats, a red buoy, and other unidentifiable debris. There is no single main subject, as the shot's purpose is to establish a sense of immense scale and desolation. The focus is on the overwhelming environment itself, using the scattered wreckage to create a somber, post-apocalyptic atmosphere.
